metadata.architecture: Frozen WavLM-Base-Plus -> ConvNeXt V2 Stem (Atto) -> Transformer Encoder -> Attention Pooling -> MLP Head

ipvs_held_out_test.description: Held-out test split of 10 completely unseen subjects (5 healthy, 5 PD) across 108 vocal recordings

threshold_0_55_val_optimized.selection_criterion: Maximizing Youden's J statistic on the validation split (never tuned on test)

mdvr_kcl_cross_dataset_generalization.dataset_name: Mobile Device Voice Recordings at King's College London (MDVR-KCL)
mdvr_kcl_cross_dataset_generalization.description: Out-of-domain cross-dataset generalization check on 37 English continuous reading speech recordings from smartphones

documented_limitations: Sample Size: The primary training dataset (IPVS) contains 65 total subjects (45 train, 10 val, 10 test). While clip counts are 831, the subject diversity is constrained.
Single Language: Training audio was exclusively Italian. English phonology, vowel formant frequencies, and prosody differ significantly.

Acoustic Channel Mismatch: The model was trained on high-grade studio condenser microphone recordings. Consumer smartphones (as in MDVR-KCL) exhibit different frequency responses, compression artifacts, and ambient noise profiles.

Task Variation: IPVS features predominantly sustained vowel phonations, reading prose, and syllable DDK tasks. Testing purely continuous reading passages from a different language resulted in severe domain shift (ROC-AUC 0.4554).
Clinical Use: This tool is strictly a screening and research decision-support aid. It cannot replace a comprehensive neurological examination, DaTscan, or clinical UPDRS evaluation.
